figures.finding: Heard Island and McDonald Islands have no directors' agreement, guild or fund: they are an uninhabited Australian external territory managed by the Australian Antarctic Division.
figures.applies: Heard Island and McDonald Islands (HM), as of 2026-11-01; any work there would be engaged from Australia (AU market files), not modeled further.

sources.said: The islands are an Australian External Territory and enjoy World Heritage protection and marine reserve status. They are managed by the Australian Antarctic Division (AAD). Heard Island and McDonald Islands are unoccupied by humans and remain largely undisturbed by human activity.
